Page 3, Defining the scope, the second and the third paragraphs are a bit unclear and
contradictory. In the second paragraph, it is mentioned that “only countries that had
conducted at least one renewable energy auction were considered”. However, in the third
paragraph, it is mentioned that “At the moment of selecting the focus countries, the
following Member States had already conducted auctions…..From these countries, the
research team selected the focus countries considering a geographical balance.” However,
some countries in these two categories are the same (e.g., Denmark and Germany).

Author Response: We included a more substantiate explanation of the criteria used for selecting
the focus countries in the manuscript and adapted the structure of this part to make it clearer.
